value.rationale: Exact objective disagreement window for time and volume reliability under the same rainfall multiset, with two sharp endpoints and an unavoidable unit-volume sacrifice in the full-demand optimum. This is a motivated complete classification for a small natural tank benchmark; it is not claimed to extend universally or describe actual rainfall control.
